Name: Kenneth's Cookie Clicker Recipes
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Cookie Clicker Recipes[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A food expansion that brings the snacks and drinks from Cookie Clicker into Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds over 200 new cooking and shop items inspired by Cookie Clicker. Made to pair with the crops mod.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Lots of cookies like Golden Cookie, Wrath Cookie, Sugar Lump Cookie, Bakeberry Cookie, Heavenly Cookie and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Biscuits and heart biscuits, including chocolate, valentine, and prism flavors[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Candies like Moon Candy, Diamond Candy, Skull Candy, Shark Candy and other weird ones from the game[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Flavored milks like Strawberry Milk, Chocolate Milk, Frostfire Milk, Sanguine Milk and a bunch more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Meals like Cheapcap Omelet, Bakeberry Pie, Gildmillet Cake and other dishes using Cookie Clicker crops[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 90 foods have cooking recipes, rest are shop items[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Food buffs included, balanced for everyday use[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The items are sold through my custom shops[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Bakery[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Dessert Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Grocery Store[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Drink Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each shop location can be changed in GMCM and defaults to Shop4.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Bakery[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Dessert Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Grocery Store[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Drink Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Cookie Clicker Crops[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for changing shop locations[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Install all required mods listed above[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
